description.value: Pizza Garden is a BC-based Neapolitan pizza chain operated by Neapolitan Pizza Ltd. with over 25 years in the industry, offering authentic wood-fired pizzas with charred crusts, sun-ripened tomatoes, and fresh mozzarella at more than a dozen locations across British Columbia. The chain supports both pickup and delivery and operates a rewards app, making it a straightforward resupply stop on longer cycling routes through urban and university-adjacent corridors.
